name: Slot
description: One cell of a Grid that holds a vertical stack of content blocks. The Grid's layout preset creates and removes slots; editors see them as columns.
summary: One Grid cell holding stacked content blocks

elements.name: Content blocks
elements.description: Any content block, stacked top to bottom; never a Section or Grid

elements.description: Color or image behind this cell only

usageNotes: Slots exist only inside a Grid. The Grid's preset (1:1, 2:1, 1:1:1) decides how many there are, so change the preset to add or remove one.
Put content blocks in a slot, never another Grid or a Section. Blocks that repeat items, such as a list of Cards, set their own number per row instead.
Render it as a plain <div>. It has no role of its own; headings inside it carry the structure.
Stacked order changes only the visual order. Keep the source order meaningful, because screen readers and keyboard focus follow the DOM (WCAG 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence, 2.4.3 Focus Order).
Make each slot a size container (container-type: inline-size) so blocks inside respond to the slot's width, not the viewport.
frameworkNotes: Only Bootstrap lists Column as its own entry. Everyone else treats it as part of Grid.
